scope: Existing component/layout and Gallery integration only; no new component registration, no DS redesign.

changes.implementation: Production Checkbox render/measure/clipped placement and existing Button interaction; Gallery actual shaped first-line metric; state matrix uses production render. Master-detail list uses one ScrollGeometry snapshot for transform/culling/clip/hit; original thumb frame painted under clip.

Existing SplitView/Slider/RadioGroup/Switch/IconButton/Link consume production normalized frame/visible geometry. Duplicate icon/link hit entries removed. Slider thumb/row hit uses visible component frame, drag mapping retains original painted track; hidden/disabled capture and stale track cleared.
Sidebar drawing/cull/hit share ScrollGeometry; full original frames transformed, only visible ranges clipped; search excluded without changing historical extent/limits.
Documented frame/visible contract, actual migration status and remaining component scope in the existing documentation.

checkbox_alignment.rule: 24pt mark center equals actual shaped label first-line line-box center. Multiline labels align the mark to first line, and row grows with full paragraph. Existing dimensions/colors/tokens retained.
checkbox_alignment.coverage: English, Chinese/Japanese/emoji, 150% text and narrow wrap via real TextEngine; pointer vs keyboard focus-visible, disabled, resize, release cancellation, Space-only activation.
checkbox_alignment.visual_change: 8 default Checkbox captures differ only in label position; other 664 default captures pixel-identical. Detail images are diagnostic nearest-neighbor crops of original captures.

checks.coverage: Includes actual Workbench click/model transitions and GPU offscreen chrome culling/reflow pixel tests; does not establish native/physical-device acceptance.

visual.manual_review: Reviewed enlarged before/after default Checkbox and checked that only label positioning changed. Multilingual/large text covered by measured geometry tests, not claimed as complete manual visual acceptance.

boundaries.pure_rust: check-pure-rust passed; no Swift/GPUI/UI framework migration.
boundaries.ds_and_routes: Design authority, generated tokens, brands and component registration unchanged; hashes checked.
boundaries.not_full_component_tree: Production geometry consumption for extended controls does not make every control a fully retained widget or finish all per-component layout/render/event encapsulation.
boundaries.animation: No new animation hookup or physics change in this batch.
boundaries.native: Not run or launched; user explicitly deferred external-screen native retest. No internal-screen substitute.

remaining: Tabs/Menu/Dialog layout/render/event encapsulation; other collection/overlay/document adapters by existing component boundaries.
External native tests: checkbox text/mark/focus, mouse/keyboard/IME, nested scrolling/resize and overlay behavior.
Full lazy provider and block text layout; viewport revision/reason notifications and frame coalescing.
120Hz/8.33ms, isolated frame drops, CPU and NSScrollView bounce acceptance remain open; no new performance claim.
VoiceOver/physical IME and final DS visual review remain separate.
